card.title: 3rd GUARDS REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 3rd Guards Rifle Regiment was part of the 4th Guards Division, which was created in the aftermath of the fighting for Yelnya, where the Soviet Army won a tactical victory against the Wehrmacht. The 4th Guards fought with distinction in numerous battles and military operations, including the Siege of Leningrad, Operation Little Saturn, the Battle of Stalingrad, the Budapest Offensive and the Vienna Offensive.
